meta.notes: ComfyUI's official 'Image Edit (Qwen-Image 2511)' graph as the model is meant to be used: the whole picture is the reference and the latent, no noise mask, the instruction decides what changes. The 8-step Lightning LoRA (LoraLoaderModelOnly after CFGNorm) as in `fill-lightning-8`. The engine masks the result layer to the selection when there is one, so a local edit shows only where the user wants it while the model still sees the whole scene. Reference images (the Generate panel's deck, `references` on generate.edit) bind `image2` and `image3` of both encoders straight from LoadImage, as the official graph wires them (the encoder scales them itself); the prompt calls them image 2 and image 3. A reference not given is pruned with its node (meta.references).
meta.creator: Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Changes the picture by instruction in 8 steps; up to two reference images
